title: Marketing Manager - Healthcare
company: DR P Alikuttys Ayurveda And Modern Hospital Kottakkal
description:
Role & responsibilities Lead and manage the hospitals overall marketing activities , including digital and offline marketing. Develop and implement marketing strategies to strengthen brand presence and business growth . Lead the digital marketing and social media team and monitor campaign performance. Plan and execute digital campaigns, advertisements, promotional activities, medical camps, outreach programs, and canvassing initiatives . Develop effective patient acquisition strategies for India, GCC, and other international markets. Identify new markets, partnerships, collaborations, and business development opportunities. Establish marketing plans, standards, campaigns, and execution processes. Monitor current digital marketing, social media, healthcare marketing, and market trends . Analyze campaign performance, lead generation, patient conversion, and ROI. Prepare regular marketing reports and performance updates for management. Coordinate with internal departments, external agencies, partners, and other stakeholders to ensure effective execution. 
 Preferred candidate profile Masters degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA preferred. 2–5 years of experience in healthcare/hospital marketing. Strong experience in digital marketing, social media marketing, branding, and business development . Proven experience in team leadership , particularly managing digital/social media marketing teams. Experience in patient acquisition and healthcare marketing . Exposure to GCC and international patient marketing will be an advantage. Strong understanding of current marketing trends, digital platforms, advertising, and lead-generation strategies. Excellent communication, analytical, planning, and leadership skills.

Key Skills: Digital Marketing,Team Leadership,Social Media Marketing,Business Growth,Patient Acquisition Strategies,Advertising Management,Hospital Marketing,Brand Marketing
